rationale: All three review lenses ran successfully. The rework correctly replaces PromptGeneratorChain with WorkflowRefinerGraph, reuses all six generation nodes, and deletes all revert code as specified. Both prior blocking findings (CR-001: broad except Exception → fixed to except KeyError; CR-002: dead revert metric → resolved by removing revert entirely) are confirmed resolved. Two new minor defensive guards are recommended: None-check on sk.INTENT in _route_from_router, and None-check on final_state['result'] before yaml_config access. Neither blocks correctness on normal paths. send_workflow_ai_refine_metric is dead code (monitoring gap, not a correctness issue). test_refine_planner.py lives in the flat test directory rather than a nodes/ subdirectory as spec prescribes, but tests pass and cover all required scenarios. Confidence is medium due to minor defensive gaps and one partial spec criterion.

findings.title: No None guard on sk.INTENT in _route_from_router before .steps access
findings.problem: _route_from_router accesses state[sk.INTENT].steps without checking if INTENT is None. WorkflowGeneratorState declares intent: Optional[Any]. If RefinePlannerNode fails via an unusual LangGraph error path that leaves sk.INTENT unset, this raises AttributeError instead of routing to END via the error guard.
findings.impact: Produces an obscured AttributeError caught by refine_workflow()'s outer except block, returning 500 with an unhelpful 'NoneType has no attribute steps' message. Normal execution paths are unaffected.
findings.recommendation: Add: intent = state.get(sk.INTENT); then guard the steps access: `if state.get(sk.CURRENT_NODE_INDEX, 0) < len(intent.steps if intent else [])` or explicitly check `if intent is None: return END`.

findings.title: No None guard on final_state['result'] before .yaml_config access
findings.problem: refine_workflow() checks final_state.get('error') and raises if set, but then accesses final_state['result'].yaml_config without verifying result is not None. If the graph exits without setting error but also without setting result (unexpected flow), this raises AttributeError caught by the outer except block.
findings.impact: Unhelpful AttributeError message in edge cases. Normal execution where the graph either sets error or sets result is unaffected.
findings.recommendation: After the error check, add: `if final_state.get('result') is None: raise ExtendedHTTPException(code=500, message='Workflow refinement produced no result', details='Graph completed without a result.', help=_REFINE_HELP_MESSAGE)`

deferred_findings_summary: 3 deferred: (1) send_workflow_ai_refine_metric defined but never called — per-operation count metric missing, token metric still emitted; (2) WorkflowRefineRequest.project accepted but silently ignored; (3) router catches only KeyError for get_workflow — broader DB errors produce 500 (pre-existing pattern across all workflow endpoints, not introduced here). 0 dismissed.
